## Vectors

* Vector $v$ in $m$ dimensional space $\mathbf{v} \in R^m$.
* Ordered list of $m$ numbers $(v_1, \dots, v_m)$.
* Typically a column vector:

$$
  \begin{align}
    \mathbf{v} &= \begin{bmatrix}
      v_1 \\
      \vdots \\
      v_m
    \end{bmatrix}
  \end{align}
$$

* Graphical representation: a point in two dimensional space.
Or a directed line segment from the origin.
Both can be useful.
